> **Reason for Removal – 1456 Lanier Pl NE, Atlanta, GA 30306**
>
> The subject tree is a [species] oak, approximately 33" DBH, located in the rear yard at the back center of the lot. The primary concern is the tree's significant lean toward the house. The trunk and main scaffold limbs extend at a pronounced angle out over the elevated rear deck and toward the roof of the home, placing the majority of the canopy's weight directly over occupied structures.
>
> The crown also contains large dead limbs positioned above the deck, stairs and roofline. The deck is an occupied gathering area used regularly by the household. A failure of the leaning stem or of these limbs would strike people, the deck, or the house.
>
> In addition, the trunk is growing directly against the rear deck stairs. The lean and the structural conflict can't be corrected by pruning: reducing the weight enough to address the lean would remove a large share of the live crown and further stress the tree.
>
> For these reasons, the property owner, Mike Hufler, has requested full removal. Sharper Edge Tree Care Inc, a registered tree service, will remove the tree in sections using climbing and rigging to protect the deck, stairs and house. We'll then haul all debris and grind the stump below grade. No construction or grading is proposed.
